sentences.text: Shri Manoj Jain - Advocate for the petitioner.

Order 
This miscellaneous petition has been preferred by the petitioner under Article 227 of the Constitution of India being aggrieved by the order dated 07.01.2024 passed in M.A.C.C. No.19/2024 by the learned Member, 1st Additional MACT, Khargone (MP), whereby the claim of respondents/claimants has been entertained despite not filing within six months of occurrence of the incident.

2. In a nutshell, the facts in brief are that a claim for compensation under the Motor Vehicles Act,
1988 was filed on 217.01.2024 regarding the injuries occurred in motor vehicles accident dated 03.10.2022 alleging the application under Section 5 of the Limitation Act, 1963.
3. Counsel for the petitioner submits that issue of limitation is under consideration before Hon'ble Apex Court for adjudication in SLP (C) No.9152/2023.

Therefore, Tribunal be directed not to pass final order NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-IND:17264 2 MP-3870-2024 in MACC No.19/2024.
4.
I have heard counsel for the parties and have perused the record.

5. In view of submission of counsel for the petitioner, it is directed that Tribunal shall proceed with Icici Lombard General Insurance Co. ... vs Mukesh on 9 July, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/178695995/
1 the case, but it shall not pass final order in the case, till disposal of the issue of limitation before the Hon'ble Apex Court.
6. With the aforesaid observation, this miscellaneous petition is disposed of.
